title: The Broken Horoscope
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, the investigating Inspector) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old cases/ep512 file had the correct culprit (Katsuragi) but was thin: it collapsed the whole trick into three generic `event` nodes and one clue, and entirely missed the tape-recorder voice-playback trick (Ran recognizing 'I'm working right now, I'll call later' as a repeated recording, not Reika speaking live) which is the transcript's actual mid-episode reveal that Reika was dead before Kurara's 5:00 visit -- that clue is added here as cB. It also gave every suspect a bare `knows` edge to the victim instead of the real, distinct extortion/blackmail relationships each of them had with her (financial extortion of Katsuragi, blackmail of Kurara over a witnessed secret, career obstruction of Yuuka), which are now `extorts`/`blackmails`/`blocks_career_of` edges plus `has_motive_against`. case_type: murder, locked room.

attrs.death_estimate: found dead in her locked office, dead roughly 3 to 3.5 hours before discovery, putting the killing around 5:00pm
attrs.business_practice: extorts money and secrets from clients under the guise of astrology readings

attrs.alibi_claim: on the phone at reception until 5:00pm, then in the living room with Tamura and Mouri
attrs.motive_detail: owed Reika full repayment of investments; she threatened to leak his insider trading to the press if he didn't pay

attrs.alibi_claim: in the living room with Mouri from around 5:00pm
attrs.ambition: was promised the astrology column by Katsuragi, but Reika opposed it
attrs.role_in_case: his tape recorder (running during the interview) is what the culprit exploited; he is briefly suspected purely for owning it

attrs.alibi_claim: brief chat with Katsuragi, then in the kitchen helping with dinner, corroborated by kitchen staff
attrs.relationship_note: Reika's niece and apprentice, treated like a servant, blocked from writing the astrology column, and stood to inherit Reika's legacy as closest relative

attrs.alibi_claim: arrived at Reika's office around 5:00 for a scheduled fortune-telling appointment; believed she heard Reika's live voice through the door
attrs.motive_detail: Reika saw her leaving her room a month earlier and threatened to expose whatever secret that implied

attrs.features: barred window, veranda, stained-glass skylight in the roof above

attrs.feature: stained-glass skylight above Reika's office, her own design, with a Scorpio image at its center

attrs.uniqueness: hollow-point key, only one exists, duplicates can only be ordered with the original credit card
attrs.found: in a mixed pile of keys and glass on the office floor after the group broke in

attrs.origin: normally kept on Reika's key ring
attrs.given_away: removed from the key ring and given away as a good-luck charm just before Reika went into her office for the day's last reading

attrs.damage: small hole cracked in the middle of the Scorpio image before the group later broke the rest of the window to get in
attrs.missing_piece: no red shard from the Scorpio image was recovered among the debris

attrs.sighting: the bird was seen flying to the roof around 5:30pm
attrs.found_position: on the office floor, underneath the later-broken glass shards

attrs.recorded_line: captured Reika saying 'I'm working right now, I'll call later' to Yuuka about an incoming TV call, earlier in the day
attrs.misuse: a recording of that line was played back near Reika's office door to make Kurara believe Reika answered her at 5:00pm, though Reika was already dead

clues.desc: A bird seen flying to the roof at 5:30 left a feather found on the office floor UNDER the later-broken window glass, and no red shard from the Scorpio image turned up among the debris -- proves a small hole was cut in the skylight before the window was fully broken to enter the room.

The line Kurara heard through the door at 5:00, 'I'm working right now, I'll call later,' was word-for-word what Reika had said earlier to her apprentice about a TV call -- it was a recorded playback, not Reika speaking live.

Katsuragi picked the correct office key from a mixed pile by its sapphire pendant, but Reika had already given that pendant away as a charm before she entered her office -- only the killer could have known which key was hers.

edges.detail: demanded full repayment of investments; threatened to leak his insider trading to the press otherwise
saw Kurara leaving her room a month earlier and threatened to expose whatever secret that implied unless Kurara found a replacement client
vetoed Katsuragi's promise to let Yuuka take over the astrology column
regularly takes her anger out on Yuuka despite treating her as an apprentice/relative
locked the office door from outside using Reika's key after killing her
played back a recording of Reika's earlier voice near the office door to make Kurara think Reika answered her at 5:00pm
cracked a small hole in the stained-glass skylight, in the middle of the Scorpio image
dropped the office key back inside through the hole in the skylight to make the room look locked from inside
suggested Yuuka must have a spare key, intending her to take the blame for the sealed room -- no spare actually exists
